translations.web: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
translations.bsb: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
translations.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
translations.asv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.
